# cloudxino_ssh_key (Data Source)

A saved SSH key, by `id`, `name` or `fingerprint`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudxino_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name = "laptop"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `public_key` (String)
